Name: 1.6 Bundle o' Recolours
Author: radmaninoff
Description:
recolours mystery items, wallet items/cursors introduced in 1.6, and patches ui elements to match other graphics mods.

[size=2]DETAILS:[/size]
all configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[list]
[*]recolours [b]mystery boxes[/b], [b]clothes[/b], and the [b]book of mysteries[/b] to a subdued purple-and-cyan palette
[*]desaturates [b]golden mystery boxes[/b]
[*]desaturates the [b]tent kit's overworld sprite[/b] (palette from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿)
[*]retextures the [b]forest magic [/b]and [b]mastery star [/b]wallet items
[*]if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21436]Vanilla Tweaks - Interface Edition[/url]﻿ is installed, the [b]book of mysteries [/b]is patched to match the mod's book sprites
[*]if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8835]Grandpa's Tools[/url]﻿ is installed, the [b]golden fishing treasure chest[/b] is patched to match the mod's fishing minigame assets
[/list]    1.0.1:[list]
[*]retextures the [b]golden tag [/b]item from the trout derby (yoinked the minecraft nametag sprite, shhh)
[*]adds [b]pride flag options [/b]for the [b]junimo easter egg [/b]in the title screen
[*]retextures the [b]gem birds [/b]in the title sequence
[*]retextures [b]robin's construction sprites [/b]to match universal recolours (currently only supports DNE!)
[/list][size=2]INSTALLATION:[/size]
[list]
[*]install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿.
[*]unzip this mod directly into your mods folder (or buried under a couple of subfolders, like i do!)
[*]boot up and enjoy!
[/list][size=2]UNINSTALLATION:[/size]
[list]
[*]drag out of your mods folder. that's it!
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
what's new:
• retextures of junimo minigame, title sequence gem birds, the golden tag item, and robin's construction sprites (DNE only)
• oodles of false dependencies for interface mods
